meta.title: Projects
meta.description: Adds a Projects workspace to the left sidebar. State a goal and the coordinator clarifies key ambiguities, dispatches isolated parallel threads automatically, and reports back upon completion; an on-demand right drawer unifies Threads, Project Library (references & artifacts), inline Instructions, and pinnable searchable Shared Memory, paired with wide Diff mergeability checks, targeted revision feedback, and three-color live status dots.
